results.title: Video of Ukrainian drone attack on Russia falsely shared as Iranian attack on Israel | Fact Check

A spokesperson for Carlson told Reuters that the posts were fake and that Carlson’s name and image had been used without his permission. The screenshot was posted on social media, opens new tab with the caption: “BOMBSHELL TUCKER RELEASED AN VIDEO FROM ZELENSKY BEING CAPTURED… HE IS BEING TRANSFERRED TO BLACK DOLPHIN PRISON (RUSSIA) WITH HIGH SECURITY…”
